title: Cell Lysis and Extraction of Total Protein from Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803
author: Anna Behle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ps6dnhe

steps.title: Prepare 1x TB buffer
steps.instruction: Make 10 mL of 1× thylakoid‑buffer (TB) containing 50 mM HEPES/NaOH (pH 7), 5 mM MgCl₂, 25 mM CaCl₂, and optionally 10 % (v/v) glycerol; add one complete ULTRA protease‑inhibitor tablet (Mini, EDTA‑free, EASYpack, Roche).

steps.title: Grow cyanobacterial culture
steps.instruction: Cultivate Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 until the optical density at 750 nm reaches 0.5–1.0.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Collect 10–20 mL of the culture and pellet the cells by centrifugation at 4500 rpm, 4 °C.

steps.title: First cell disruption
steps.instruction: Keep the pellet on ice, resuspend it in 200 µL of 1× TB, add an equal volume of glass beads (0.1 mm + 0.25 mm mixed 1:1), and disrupt in a Precellys homogenizer (4000 rpm, 2 × 30 s bursts with a 15 s pause, then return to ice). Use tubes compatible with the homogenizer to avoid breakage.

steps.title: First low‑speed spin and bead wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 4000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 min; transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube, add 200 µL 1× TB to the beads to wash them, and repeat the disruption step (same bead mixture and Precellys program).

steps.title: Second low‑speed spin and combine extracts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the second lysate at 4000 rpm, 4 °C for 5 min and add its supernatant to the supernatant collected after the first spin.

steps.title: High‑speed clarification
steps.instruction: Spin the combined extract at maximum speed (e.g., ≥14 000 rpm) for 30 min to 1 h at 4 °C. The soluble protein will be in a blue supernatant; the membrane pellet will appear green. Verify removal of chlorophyll by measuring the absorption spectrum of the supernatant and confirming that the 665 nm peak is absent.
